testimonials.title: Do not take our word for it — hear from students and teachers

items.alex: I book 25-minute classes between meetings. My teacher from Guatemala catches my mistakes every week — it finally feels natural when I speak.
items.priya: The paired option let my sister and I practice Spanish together with one native teacher. We split the cost and still get personal feedback.
items.maria: As a teacher based in Guatemala, the schedule tools and payout visibility are straightforward — I focus on conversation, not admin.

programs.title: Spanish programs for your level and goals
programs.subtitle: Immersion tracks with native Guatemalan teachers — conversation, beginners, or paired learning.

spanish.title: Live Spanish
spanish.summary: Every class is in Spanish with a native teacher from Guatemala — real conversation, pronunciation, and grammar you can use the same day.

natives.title: Guatemalan teachers
natives.summary: Learn from native speakers rooted in Guatemala: natural rhythm, local expressions, and cultural context you cannot get from recorded lessons.

beginners.title: First steps
beginners.summary: Greetings, core verbs, and guided speaking from class one — friendly pace, instruction entirely in Spanish with support when you need it.

conversation.title: Conversation focus
conversation.summary: Less drill, more dialogue: storytelling, situational role-play, and corrections in context with your Guatemalan teacher.

paired.title: Paired classes
paired.summary: Share a native teacher with a partner, split the package, and keep each other accountable — still 100% Spanish, still live.

teachers.title: Teach with us
teachers.summary: Native Spanish educators join the roster, set weekly availability, and teach 1:1 or paired live classes on our classroom platform.

features.title: Everything you need for Spanish fluency
features.subtitle: Native-led live classes and the same tools students use inside the academy dashboard.

spanishOnly.title: Spanish only
spanishOnly.description: All live instruction is in Spanish — built for learners who want immersion, not translation drills.
